checks.evidence: Frozen release contains the model and llama-server plus bundled dylibs; launcher invokes only packaged runtime. No separately installed llama-server was used.

First normal packaged launch used bundled model/runtime; runtime policy has network_downloads=false and launcher has no runtime/model fetch path. Model SHA remained the frozen value; final live AI process had only its loopback listener and no external socket.
Frozen candidate hashes match model/runtime manifests and candidate-freeze metadata; tamper test rejected altered runtime and restored SHA matched.
Packaged start automatically launched AI and returned ready; final consolidated start observed a live candidate PID and 127.0.0.1:8767 listener.
Runtime manifest records Metal enabled; final live candidate process loaded bundled libggml-metal.0.dylib and the expected GGUF (lsof identity inspection).
Packaged launcher Docker-core probe passed; API health returned embedded_local ready through packaged core and host.docker.internal route.
Playwright on frozen candidate UI displayed Local embedded AI ready; screenshot at artifacts/embedded-ai/eai14-b64a0fd-ui.png.
Synthetic high_rtt investigation completed model_assisted with one accepted tcp.rtt category, 17 evidence links, and unchanged original SHA; see eai14-b64a0fd-case.json.

Frozen candidate UI invoked both Full Capture and Evidence Capture in native Wireshark. Filter tcp.stream == 0; derived artifact SHA and parent capture SHA are recorded in eai14-b64a0fd-native-artifacts.json and eai14-b64a0fd-ui-actions.json.

Terminated only the PID after confirming its executable path was the frozen candidate runtime. API stayed healthy; a new case returned model_fallback/runtime-unhealthy and retained deterministic tcp.rtt; see eai14-b64a0fd-fallback.json.
Packaged stop/start returned AI ready; earlier model-assisted case, report, capture hash, and 17 evidence rows remained retrievable; see eai14-b64a0fd-recovery.json.
Release, isolated HOME, data root, and captures used paths containing spaces; packaged stop/start preserved candidate data and model assets.
Controlled loopback listener on 127.0.0.1:8767 produced explicit port-in-use status and healthy deterministic-only API.
Flipping one byte in extracted disposable candidate runtime caused invalid-bundle and deterministic-only health; byte was restored and runtime SHA reverified before restart.
Final consolidated lsof capture showed app 127.0.0.1:28765, bridge 127.0.0.1:28766, AI 127.0.0.1:8767 only. AI had no external network socket.
Current ephemeral AI key was absent from runtime log and isolated data root; prior security/privacy sentinels and adversarial suite passed, and full current-head suite is being rerun.

limitations: First-launch no-download finding is established from the packaged offline runtime/model and launcher path, the network_downloads=false manifest policy, unchanged model SHA, and observed no external llama-server socket; this was not a packet capture of all host traffic.
